args.body:
**Error in the 3% increase I applied on 2026-10-14.** A catalog check flagged that 22 products marked FIXED-PRICE CONTRACT (P-1201 to P-1222) were increased 3%. They should have been excluded.
- Since then, 8 orders (SO-77310 to SO-77317) were placed at the increased prices. The total overcharge is 4,128.60.
- I haven't verified these figures independently. I haven't changed any prices yet.
- Proposed fix: revert P-1201 to P-1222 to their pre-increase prices, then have sales ops and finance correct or credit the 8 orders.
- Decision for you: should I revert the prices now? I need the original price list if the catalog history doesn't have it.

FYI, orders SO-77310 to SO-77317 were billed at prices 3% too high on fixed-price contract products (P-1201 to P-1222). The cause was my error in last week's price increase. The overcharge is 4,128.60. I've told Lena Ortiz and proposed reverting the prices. Your team may want to hold or correct those orders and tell the affected customers.
